Class DoubleParameter

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<Double>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.RangeParameter<Double>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.DoubleParameter
public class DoubleParameter extends RangeParameter<Double>
A parameter representing a double value constrained within a specified inclusive range.

This class is a concrete implementation of RangeParameter for the Double type. It supports automatic parsing from command-line style arguments and validation against the configured bounds.

Example usage: 

DoubleParameter param = new DoubleParameter("threshold", 0.0, 1.0);
param.parse(new String[] { "--threshold", "0.5" });
Double value = param.value(); // 0.5
Author:
Antonio J. Nebro
